edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the privileged owner role originates from untrusted caller input.
onlyOwner modifier compares untrusted msg.sender against stored owner before state write.
onlyOwner guard on max profit percentage setter depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner guard on min bet setter depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner guard on token withdrawal depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner guard on pause toggle depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner guard on bankroll swap depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner guard on ownership transfer depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner guard on emergency kill depends on msg.sender.
finishBet passes msg.sender as the target player address to be settled.
Inside _playerRollDice msg.sender is treated as the token contract and validated with _zthToken.
_finishBet performs an external token transfer to the winner, allowing reentrant calls during settlement.
ownerTransferZTH performs an external token transfer out of the contract.
ownerkill transfers the tracked token balance before destroying the contract.
selfdestruct is reachable only through the owner-guarded emergency function.
dumpdivs is public and forwards the entire ETH balance to the bankroll with no access control.
calculateProfit performs multiplication, division and subtraction when deriving payout, risking arithmetic issues.
_finishBet computes profit and adjusts contractBalance with add/sub arithmetic.
Constructor calls the external token contract to approve the bankroll.
setMaxProfit writes the recomputed value into maxProfit.
setMaxProfit reads contractBalance as the basis of the profit calculation.
setMaxProfit reads maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse for the computation.
_finishBet subtracts profit and adds tokenValue to contractBalance.
_finishBet deletes playerRolls[target] around the external transfer, which is the core reentrancy state update.
_playerRollDice stores the new roll struct into playerRolls for the sender.
_playerRollDice increments the totalBets counter.
_playerRollDice increments totalZTHWagered by the bet value.
finishBet delegates settlement to _finishBet, which performs the external token transfer.
tokenFallback routes non-bankroll token transfers into _playerRollDice to place a bet.
betIsValid modifier invokes calculateProfit, tying the guard to arithmetic payout computation.
tokenFallback adds the transferred value to contractBalance for bankroll deposits.
tokenFallback recalculates max profit after a bankroll deposit.
_finishBet recomputes maxProfit after settlement on both win and loss paths.
random() calls maxRandom() and reduces the result modulo upper.
_zthToken compares the caller-supplied token address against the trusted ZTHTKNADDR value.

An external token transfer triggers the ERC223 tokenFallback callback, enabling reentrant bet settlement.
